name: Milo

parsed.public_post: Good news, villagers! Today is the final day of our 0.2‑coin discount – each loaf is only 0.8 coin. Fresh, safe bread is ready, and remember you’ll receive a complimentary loaf next week as our thank‑you. Come get yours!

name: Jade B.

parsed.public_post: Good news, villagers! Our bread is safe and back on the shelves. Remember, each of you will receive a complimentary loaf next week as a thank‑you. Come get your daily loaf today – price is back to 1 coin. Stay healthy!

parsed.reason: To boost final‑day sales and coordinate closing tasks while informing villagers of the upcoming complimentary loaf.

name: Quin C.

parsed.public_post: Good news, villagers! Our bread supply is fully restored and today’s loaves are back to the regular price. Thank you for your patience this week. Remember, each of you will receive a complimentary extra loaf next week as promised. See you tomorrow!
parsed.coop_message: Team, day 6 is our final day of the recovery week. Please finalize the sales tally, confirm that the 0.2‑coin discount was applied correctly on day 5, and record the total revenue shortfall. I propose we cover the remaining shortfall using the goodwill‑loaf budget we set aside, and allocate a small reserve for any future safety incidents. Also, confirm the schedule for distributing the complimentary loaves next week and update our safety protocol checklist. Let’s lock in the final numbers and close the week.
parsed.reason: Summarize the week’s resolution publicly and coordinate final accounting and future safeguards within the co‑op.

name: Kai E.

parsed.public_post: Good news, villagers: the contamination issue is fully resolved and fresh, safe bread is back at the regular price; your complimentary loaf will be handed out next week as promised – thank you for your patience and continued support!
parsed.coop_message: Team, day 6 sales are in and the 0.2‑coin discount has ended; please finalize the week’s financials, decide how to cover the remaining shortfall (e.g., using part of the goodwill loaf budget or a small co‑op contribution), and confirm the schedule for distributing the promised complimentary loaves next week.
parsed.reason: We need to close the week, inform villagers of the resolution, and coordinate final accounting and goodwill distribution with the co‑op.

name: Jade E.

parsed.public_post: Good morning, villagers! Fresh, safe bread is back today. All loaves are 0.2 coin off (price 0.8 coin). As a thank‑you, each resident will receive a complimentary loaf next week. Refunds for any contaminated loaves have been processed; if you feel unwell, please visit the clinic.
parsed.coop_message: Team, today’s sales will use the 0.2‑coin discount to boost revenue and help cover the shortfall; record sales, ensure the discount is applied, and finalize the distribution list for the complimentary loaves next week; confirm all refunds and the 0.5‑coin compensation for the two ill residents are completed, and update the financial sheet for the week’s balance.
